newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March copper cable shipments, orders up.
newsitem.headline: Japan March copper cable shipments, orders up.

text.p: Japanese copper wire and cable shipments rose 3.5 percent in March, compared with the same period last year, while orders climbed 4.6 percent, the Japanese Electric Wire and Cable Makers' Association said on Thursday.
The association said an increase in shipments to the automobile and construction industries had more than offset a decline in shipments to the telecommunications and electric power sectors.

Tsuneo Hiratsuka, managing director of the association, told reporters it was still to be determined whether the rise in the national sales tax in April would hurt demand in the coming months. Demand from the automobile sector seemed to be strong at least until June, he said.
